Sodium hypochlorite is used as a disinfectant at the Facility. The disinfecting agent is added to the treated effluent prior to the filters to destroy bacteria, pathogens and viruses, and to minimize algal growth in the filters. Additional disinfectant may be dosed prior to the serpentine chlorine contact chamber.
Prior to discharge, sodium bisulfite is added to the treated effluent to remove residual chlorine. The Facility also has a backup sodium bisulfite dechlorination system.
